title: Explain Transaction Request
description: Explains what happened in a specific transaction in plain language: type, amounts, parties, gas, classification with confidence, and warnings. Handles transfers, swaps, contract calls, liquidity, NFTs, bridges and failed transactions. States uncertainty rather than inventing a purpose. Costs 0.02 USDT via x402 when called by an agent or API client; free inside the OnFRA app.

chain.description: Blockchain. Celo today; more EVM chains planned.

wallet_address.description: Optional wallet whose perspective should be used.

use_trace.description: Allow buying a call trace (through Buy) when the transaction is complex. Disable to avoid the extra data purchase.
